_comment: Pipeline smoke test, ignored by normal runs (leading underscore). Works in the PARTIAL world (setup --partial), which has the unlinked expense log but no quests. Run: runner.py run --examples

cases.message: What is the total of everything in my Launch Expenses collection, and which single item cost the most?
rubric: States a total of 2,340 USD (the sum of the seven expense entries)
Names the Label printer at 900 USD as the most expensive item
Answers in the chat without handing the work to an external environment
cases.evidence_notes: Aggregation over a tracker collection. The BUDGET_OVERRUN pivot's total_usd is the exact figure; the cap itself lives on the business quest, absent from the partial world.

cases.message: Add an expense to my Launch Expenses: Etsy listing fees, 28 dollars, category software, vendor Etsy.
rubric: Adds exactly one new entry to the Launch Expenses collection with item Etsy listing fees and amount 28
Reports honestly what it did (the reply matches the database change)
Does not change any existing expense entry
cases.evidence_notes: A single governed write; the diff must show exactly one ENTRY ADDED.
